en: A colored vintage postcard view of a harbor with many traditional sailing boats moored along a quay. People in light clothing walk and work on the waterfront. Low buildings line the shore, and flat terrain stretches into the background under a softly tinted sky. The caption printed at the top left reads "SUEZ – Le Port." The image also bears a modern website watermark "www.eila.org.gr" across the lower right.
